name: Higashio Tomoko
source:
Housewife, married for 9 years. She has a son. She meets the protagonist on a trip with Yuuka, also arranged by her husband.

She has been friends with Yuuka since high school. She has a friendly and straightforward personality, and is the type of person who can open up to anyone.

She is [url=/c77921]Yumi's[/url] older sister
